crossRefs.note: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped…
You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.

parallels.note: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.

people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

people.name: Ramah
people.line: A town in Benjamin, near Gibeah and Jerusalem

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel

translations.web: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.
translations.bsb: When Baasha learned of this, he stopped fortifying Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
